name: Minister Christian
overview: The role of the Minister Christian is rooted in a divine calling to serve faithfully in the presence of God, as demonstrated by Aaron and his sons who were appointed to minister in the priestly office. Scripture reveals the serious responsibility of ministers to uphold God's commands, exemplified by the tragic consequences faced by Nadab and Abihu when they offered unauthorized fire before the Lord. This underscores the holiness required of those who minister, as God is to be sanctified and glorified through their service. Furthermore, God’s promise to be with the mouth of the minister, teaching what to say, affirms the divine guidance essential for fulfilling this sacred office.
